name: Kit
description: Kit lets agents read subscribers, tags, segments, sequences, and broadcasts, manage subscribers, and draft broadcasts in the signed-in Kit account. It never sends a broadcast, and it needs a paid Kit plan.

prompts.text: How many subscribers did I gain this month, and from which forms?
Compare the open and click rates of my last five broadcasts.
Draft a broadcast that announces my new workshop.

apps.name: Kit
apps.description: Subscribers, tags, sequences, and broadcast drafts, over Kit's MCP server with browser sign-in.
